_about: Which species may be made as a physical figurine. Jake decided (Nov 24 2026): every game species is a product, including Star-Lord Kek, Lord Kek, FUNTRUMP, Homer Pepe, The White Rabbit and Nakamoto. stop = the tool will not make a print file unless run with --allow-stop. ask = shows a reminder on the order sheet. A hybrid takes the strictest level of its parents. Species not listed count as ask (a new species added to the game later), so add new species here. Edit this file to change it.
